about.subtitle: Thoughts, images & moments from everyday life.
about.about_text: I am a passionate creator, developer and designer, focused on Web frontend development, UI/UX design and brand visuals. I believe good design is not just about appearance, but a way of thinking that solves problems. Every line of code, every pixel, carries respect and pursuit of user experience.
about.job1_desc: Provide design, development and consulting services for multiple brands and personal projects.
about.job2_desc: Responsible for product frontend architecture, component library design and user experience optimization.
about.skills_frontend_list: HTML/CSS, JavaScript, React, Vue, Next.js, Three.js
about.skills_tools_list: Git, VS Code, Webpack, Vite, Tailwind CSS
about.edu_desc: Major in software engineering, minor in visual design. Participated in multiple open source projects during school.
about.log1_text: Today I redesigned my personal website, moved the About page content to the Contact page, and turned this place into my daily log. I want to record everyday life in a simpler way — some random thoughts, photos taken on the go, or things I see. I hope this corner can hold traces of time.
about.log2_text: Recently I've been increasingly drawn to minimalist design. Not emptiness, but just-right留白. Every element has a reason to exist, no more no less. Doing subtraction in design is often harder than addition. You have to dare to delete things that "look good but serve no purpose".
about.log3_text: It has been raining for three days. The city in the rain has a special atmosphere — the grey sky makes the street lights feel warmer. Passing by a café, seeing the dim yellow light and people reading through the glass, I felt that life was beautiful at that moment.
about.log4_text: A visual experiment made with Three.js. About light, shadow, time and flow. Though just a few lines of code, the feeling of creation when seeing it come alive is still there.
